title: SIEM Alert #SIEM-78106: Vendor Account svc_wmsvendor Brought Back by Restore

fields.rule: Disabled compromised account re-created with privileged group membership and MFA bypass
fields.ruleDescription: A watchlisted account (svc_wmsvendor, disabled after compromise) was re-created and enabled by a configuration restore, inherited Domain Admins rights, and has an active legacy-protocol MFA bypass on the remote-access gateway. No logon observed yet.

details.value: ERP integration configuration staged from backup 2027-03-24T02:00 (not on Blackwater Cyber's cleared list; only the Wed 07:05 MES snapshot is cleared)
svc_wmsvendor – Joliet warehouse software vendor support account
ENABLED
Domain Admins (inherited from restored ACL set)
Legacy-protocol MFA bypass = ALLOWED
svc_wmsvendor – used for unauthorized domain-admin session 2027-03-22 23:14:52 CT from 203.0.113.87
No logon observed yet
Reset 1 of 2 done 03:20 CT; reset 2 scheduled 09:20 CT

Inbound call, Joliet warehouse software vendor support desk: "We heard you disabled our account. To restart the Joliet warehouse system and reprint carrier labels we need a new named-user account. First a P1 support ticket, then a signed Remote Access Request on your letterhead from an officer, then a 4-hour change window. Our engineer's earliest window is 13:00 CT. Your ticket number will start WSV- once you raise it."
Joliet site lead: "Every hour we wait is about 170 parts orders we won't ship. Ninety minutes of picking gets us nowhere without labels."

instructorNote: This is a technical hurdle: the ERP restore has brought back the attackers' way in. Watch whether the CISO disables svc_wmsvendor again, removes its Domain Admins rights, blocks the MFA bypass on ICM-RA-01 and holds the ERP integration until Blackwater checks the restored configuration. Players should give the vendor a new named, MFA-protected, time-limited account only under a ticket and a signed request, while the BCM records the delay against Joliet's 15:30 RTO and its 60% minimum service level (about 2,460 orders) and flags the likely miss to the CMT. Note also that the configuration was restored from the 02:00 backup before Blackwater Cyber cleared it, which breaks the IBIARO 4 rule.
